name: Montenegrin nationalism
summary: Montenegrin nationalism holds that Montenegrins are a nation in their own right, distinct from the Serbs, with their own language, culture, church and state. In its mainstream form since the late 1990s it is a state-building and largely civic project that achieved independence by referendum in 2006 and pursued Euro-Atlantic integration.
scope: The mainstream strand since 1997: the pro-independence nationalism of the Djukanovic-era Democratic Party of Socialists, the 2006 referendum and the 2007 constitution, plus the language and Montenegrin Orthodox Church campaigns. It is not the interwar Greens' royalism or the WWII Federalists' Greater Montenegro, and not the pro-Serbian unionist tradition. It has no economic doctrine of its own, so economic answers are mostly low-confidence inferences from the dominant party.

keyFigures.name: Milo Đukanović
keyFigures.role: Led the Democratic Party of Socialists from 1998 to 2023 and the pro-independence campaign that won the 2006 referendum.

keyFigures.name: Sekula Drljević
keyFigures.role: Theoretician of the interwar Montenegrin Federalist Party who promoted a separate Montenegrin ethnicity.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The 2007 constitution guarantees everyone health protection (Art. 69), which the state-building mainstream accepts as a baseline.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; inferred from the dominant party's social-democratic label, though its Third Way economics tempers this.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Inferred from the dominant nationalist party's Third Way, market-friendly record; nationalism itself has no economic doctrine.

public-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the neoliberal-leaning privatising record of the dominant pro-independence party; no source states a nationalist position.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Inferred from the party's market-oriented Third Way economics; the nationalist movement has no documented tax programme.

unions-good.rationale: Inferred from the dominant party's membership in social-democratic international bodies; not a nationalist matter as such.

property-fundamental.rationale: Art. 58 of the constitution guarantees property rights, allowing deprivation only in the public interest with compensation.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Adherents are split between the party's market orientation and its social-democratic label; sources do not address it.

cut-welfare.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's duty to support those unable to work (Art. 67) and a social-justice state.

worker-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the party's Third Way economics; no nationalist source supports worker ownership.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Inferred from a security-minded state-building mainstream; not documented in the sources.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a generally conservative Balkan social outlook.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Inferred from constitutional bans on forced assimilation and the minority-protection framework (Art. 80); not addressed directly.

strong-leader.rationale: Adherents are split: Djukanovic's long dominance was criticised as authoritarian, yet sources do not show nationalism demanding bypassing gridlock.

state-harmful.rationale: Nationalism here is a state-building project whose goal was an independent, sovereign state, defined as a civil state of social justice.

limit-guns.rationale: Inferred from Montenegro's traditional arms-bearing culture; sources are silent.

empower-police-military.rationale: Inferred from the independence-era state-building and NATO membership; not directly documented.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a conventional Balkan social outlook.

decide-locally.rationale: Inferred from the unitary nation-state framework of the constitution; no source states a position.

rehabilitation.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's rule-of-law, human-rights framing; not documented.

traditional-family.rationale: Inferred from nationalist emphasis on tradition; not directly documented in the sources.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Adherents are split between Europeanist modernisers and traditionalists; sources do not address it.

abortion-legal.rationale: Inferred from the dominant party's centre-left, Europeanist stance and Yugoslav-era legal tradition.

more-religion-public.rationale: Art. 14 separates religious communities from the state, though the nationalist movement backs its own church's public standing.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Racial injustice is not a Montenegrin political theme; neutral inference only.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Inferred from a traditionalist national culture; not addressed by sources.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The movement rests on defending a distinct Montenegrin culture, language and church against absorption into Serbian identity.

gradual-change.rationale: The movement spans gradualists and radical revivalists; sources do not give a single line.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; adherents have no documented consensus.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Inferred from the Euro-Atlantic orientation of the dominant nationalist party.

free-trade.rationale: Inferred from the Europeanist, market-friendly orientation of the dominant party.

nation-first.rationale: Inferred from Atlanticist, Europeanist foreign policy that places cooperation with the West ahead of narrow interest.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Inferred from the Atlanticist foreign policy and Western alignment; not documented as a nationalist position.

open-borders.rationale: Inferred from a nation-state project; not addressed by the sources.

limit-growth.rationale: Montenegro's constitution calls it ecological, but the state's development model is growth and tourism driven; inferred.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Inferred loosely from the constitutional self-description as an ecological state; not a nationalist issue.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Inferred from the constitutional ecological-state self-image; not documented.

revolution-justified.rationale: Independence was pursued through a referendum in 2006, suggesting a constitutional, not revolutionary, route.

experts-over-public.rationale: Inferred from sovereignty resting with citizens (Art. 2); not addressed directly.

central-planning.rationale: Inferred from the dominant party's turn from Yugoslav-era socialism to Third Way economics.

socialized-markets.rationale: Inferred from the party's market-oriented record; not a nationalist issue.

land-value-tax.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from conventional market economics.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from market-oriented economics and strong family ties.

basic-income.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from fiscal conservatism of the dominant party.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Inferred from the open, Europeanist trade orientation of the dominant party.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Adherents are split between the state-led record of the ruling party and its market orientation.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Not addressed; property rights are guaranteed but no distributist position is documented.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Inferred from the party's market orientation.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Inferred from adoption of the euro and mainstream finance.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from Western-style liberal market orientation.

one-party-rule.rationale: The constitution establishes a democratic civil state; nationalism here is a pluralist project, not a vanguard-party one.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Split: the Petrovic-Njegos dynasty is revered by the Greens tradition, but the modern state is a republic.

democracy-best.rationale: The constitution defines Montenegro as democratic, and the referendum route to independence reflects it.

direct-votes.rationale: The 2006 referendum shows comfort with direct votes on national questions, but sources show no general doctrine.

workers-councils.rationale: Inferred from the party's turn from socialism; no source supports it.

right-to-secede.rationale: Montenegro's own independence was achieved by the 2006 referendum separating it from the union with Serbia.

natural-rulers.rationale: Inferred from the constitutional equality of citizens; not addressed.

political-violence-never.rationale: Inferred from the peaceful referendum path in the dominant party's programme; the historic Federalists differ.

war-builds-character.rationale: Not addressed; inferred, though Montenegrin heroic-warrior folklore exists in national culture.

separate-church-state.rationale: Art. 14 states that religious communities are separated from the state, though nationalists also fight for church recognition.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: The constitution is civil, with churches separated from the state, so scripture is not a legal source.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Inferred from a state-building project; no source supports privatised justice.

military-superiority.rationale: Inferred from a very small state that joined NATO rather than seeking dominance.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The preamble defines Montenegro as a state of free and equal citizens of several peoples, a civic rather than ethnic nation.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Inferred from the party's turn from socialism; nationalism sees history as national, not class-based.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Inferred from the dominant party's market orientation; not addressed.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Not a Montenegrin issue; no documented position.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Not addressed; no documented position in the sources.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Inferred from a constitution built on citizens' rights and equal liberties.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Inferred loosely from the constitution's self-description as an ecological state.

limit-population.rationale: Not addressed; a nationalist movement in a small country would not favour limiting population.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a development-oriented state.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from citizen sovereignty in the constitution.

restore-past-order.rationale: The mainstream is a modernising, Europeanist state project, though revivalists stress past statehood.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The dominant party is a pragmatic catch-all, but nationalist sources show no doctrine on this.

direct-action.rationale: Independence was reached through elections and a referendum.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Not addressed; no plausible support in nationalism.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the party's market orientation.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Inferred from the party's turn from socialism to market economics.

production-for-use.rationale: Inferred from the party's turn from socialism to market economics.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Inferred from the party's turn from socialism to market economics.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Inferred from the party's break with Yugoslav-era communism.

collective-farming.rationale: Inferred from the post-socialist move to private property (Art. 58).

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Inferred from the party's turn from socialism to Western alignment.

taxation-theft.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's state-of-social-justice duties funded by taxes.

harm-principle.rationale: Not addressed; split between liberal modernisers and conservative traditionalists.

conscription.rationale: Inferred from Montenegro's move to a professional army alongside NATO membership.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on sovereign citizen self-government.

state-as-business.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a state-building rather than libertarian outlook.

positive-liberty.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's social-justice state and material security provisions (Art. 67).

hereditarian-race.rationale: Inferred from the constitutional equality of citizens; not addressed.

organic-representation.rationale: Inferred from citizens' direct sovereignty through elected representatives (Art. 2).

total-state.rationale: The constitution establishes a civil, democratic state; the historic Federalists' authoritarian turn is not the mainstream.

national-rebirth.rationale: The dominant strand is a normalised European state project rather than a decadence-and-rebirth myth.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Mainstream Montenegrin nationalism criticises Bulatovic's claims to Dubrovnik and parts of Herzegovina; only the WWII Federalists sought Greater Montenegro.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Inferred from citizen sovereignty under the constitution.

bound-labor.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's right to work and equality.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; Montenegro has no documented stance as a nationalist matter.

revive-national-language.rationale: Montenegrin was standardised and made the official language in 2007 as an element of identity, though it was not extinct.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Inferred from the party's market orientation; not addressed.

school-vouchers.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a public-education tradition.

economic-freedom.rationale: Inferred from the Third Way market orientation of the dominant party.

rule-by-example.rationale: Inferred from the rule-of-law basis of the constitution (Art. 1).

national-self-determination.rationale: The movement's core claim is that Montenegrins are a nation entitled to define themselves and have their own state, realised in 2006.

force-without-un.rationale: Montenegro stayed neutral in the Kosovo war and is Atlanticist, but nationalism has no stated line.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Split: the movement champions its own national church, but sources show no stance on reason versus faith.

class-collaboration.rationale: Inferred from the catch-all, Third Way approach of the dominant party.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The movement is defined by guarding national culture and heritage such as the Cetinje church and language.

dominated-front.rationale: Inferred from the pro-Western alignment of the dominant party.

workers-nation.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from national rather than class framing.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Inferred from constitutional equality of citizens; not documented as a nationalist position.

ban-interest.rationale: Inferred from conventional market finance and the euro adoption.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The constitution bans forced assimilation and guarantees equality of citizens and minorities.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Inferred from the party's break with Marxism.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Not addressed; split between ecological-state rhetoric and development aims.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Art. 80 prohibits forced assimilation of minority nations; immigration itself is not addressed.

elite-replacement.rationale: Inferred from the civic framework; no source shows this conspiracy narrative.

proportional-representation.rationale: Inferred from Montenegro's list-PR electoral system used throughout the dominant party's rule.

national-mission.rationale: Not addressed; a small state's nationalism has no documented universal mission.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Adherents of the ruling-party strand reject it, though critics describe the same elite as kleptocratic.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Inferred from human rights and equality commitments in the constitution.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Not addressed; adherents have no documented consensus.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The constitution establishes a social-justice state with material security and health duties.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: The preamble stresses equal citizens of several peoples, and the self-identity model of "Orthodox Montenegrin" is not racial.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The constitution proclaims free and equal citizens and bans forced assimilation of minorities.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Not applicable to a post-socialist national movement.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Inferred from equality before law and separation of religious communities from the state (Art. 14).

restrict-conversion.rationale: Inferred from constitutional religious freedom and equality of religious communities.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Not addressed; irrelevant to Montenegrin tradition.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Split: Art. 14 separation points one way, nationalist backing of a national church the other.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Not applicable; inferred from the post-socialist, democratic orientation.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Art. 2 makes sovereignty rest with citizens exercising power directly or through representatives.

population-transfer.rationale: Art. 80 prohibits forced assimilation and the constitution guarantees minority rights; the movement's mainstream is civic.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a non-Darwinian national outlook.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Inferred from the movement's framing of independence as freedom from Serbian domination of Montenegrin identity.

separated-powers.rationale: Inferred from the rule-of-law, democratic basis of the constitution.

vanguard-party.rationale: Inferred from the dominant party's break with Leninist politics.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Not addressed directly; the social-justice clause points mildly the other way.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The preamble presents Montenegro as a civic state of several peoples; the movement does not frame diversity as a threat.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Not addressed; elections are the constitutional method.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Inferred from the rule-of-law basis of Art. 1.

party-controls-media.rationale: Inferred from the democratic constitution; critics' claims of media capture do not make it a stated doctrine.

party-commands-army.rationale: Inferred from the constitutional democratic order.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The dominant nationalist party is pro-European and the constitution allows EU accession (Art. 15).

head-commands-forces.rationale: Inferred from a parliamentary republic framework; not documented.

church-by-bishops.rationale: The Montenegrin Orthodox Church follows the Orthodox episcopal model; this is inferred.

clerical-rule.rationale: The constitution separates religious communities from the state, so clerical rule is excluded.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Inferred from the movement's state-building loyalty to its own state.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Inferred from constitutional freedoms; not documented.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Not addressed; the long Djukanovic tenure is criticised, but sources show no doctrine.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: The dominant nationalist party is Atlanticist and Montenegro joined NATO.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from market orientation.

people-in-arms.rationale: Inferred from the professional army and NATO membership.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Not addressed; Montenegrin highland identity is romanticised, but no doctrine.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: The movement rejects union with Serbia and opposes claims to extend Montenegro over neighbouring lands.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Inferred from equality of peoples and minorities in the preamble.

death-penalty.rationale: Inferred from Montenegro's Council of Europe orientation; not documented in the sources.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Inferred from the Europeanist party orientation.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Inferred from secular schooling tradition; not documented.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Not addressed; the constitution speaks of citizenship generally.

minority-language-support.rationale: Arts. 79-80 guarantee minorities their language, alphabet and education; Serbian, Bosniac, Albanian and Croatian are in official use.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Inferred from the market-oriented party and euro adoption.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: The movement treated political independence as the main goal, not property transformation.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Inferred from the democratic constitution, though critics saw hybrid-authoritarian practice.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: A tiny NATO member would not seek one; inferred.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Montenegro's unilateral adoption of the euro reflects a stability-first approach, though not a stated nationalist doctrine.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Inferred loosely from the ecological-state clause.

collective-defense.rationale: The dominant nationalist party is Atlanticist and Montenegro joined NATO.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Inferred from the Atlanticist and pro-sovereignty stance, including condemnation of Russian aggression against Ukraine.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Inferred from a presidential head of state representing the republic.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Inferred from the movement's own secession from the union with Serbia.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Inferred from the civil, republican constitution.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Inferred from Montenegro's low-tax, market-friendly policy; not documented in the sources.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Art. 1 bases the state on the rule of law.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Inferred from the party's break with Marxism.

land-redistribution.rationale: Inferred from guarantee of property rights.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: A NATO member with its own army; not addressed beyond that.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: The dominant nationalist party is Atlanticist and Montenegro joined NATO; it was neutral in the 1999 Kosovo war only.

property-franchise.rationale: The constitution gives sovereignty to all citizens.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Art. 1 bases the state on the rule of law.

racial-franchise.rationale: The preamble and Arts. 2 and 79-80 give equal citizenship to all peoples.

open-government-data.rationale: Inferred from the democratic and EU-accession orientation.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: The constitution is civil and guarantees equality.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Contrary to equal citizenship and minority protection.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Not addressed; the MOC claims autocephaly but has no doctrinal line on this.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Critics tie the ruling elite to wealth, but the movement states no doctrine.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Inferred from the NATO and EU orientation of the dominant party.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: The constitution separates religion from the state without promoting atheism, and the movement champions a national church.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a state-building project.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: The constitution gives minorities rights but the statement is not addressed.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's state social-support duties (Art. 67).

term-limits.rationale: Inferred from the democratic framework; not documented.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: The MOC follows the Orthodox model; inferred.

abolish-ip.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from EU alignment.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Not addressed; the civic mainstream does not use it.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Inferred from a traditionally martial national culture.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: The movement dates Montenegrin culture to the Middle Ages, with continuity from the independent principality.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; inferred as a rejection from the traditionalist cultural outlook of the national movement.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Inferred from national-heroic folklore; not documented in the sources.

culture-before-state.rationale: The movement sought the state first, in 2006, and the language and church followed.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: The constitution protects equal rights and property for all citizens.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Not addressed; the movement defended Montenegro's own borders rather than merging regions.

independent-unions.rationale: Inferred from the social-democratic party orientation.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Inferred from health protection and social-justice duties.

second-chamber.rationale: Not addressed; Montenegro has a unicameral parliament.

municipal-property.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from market orientation.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Inferred from a unitary state framework.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Inferred from the euro and mainstream finance regulation.

person-over-state.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's rights framework.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Inferred from religious revival aspects of the movement.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The civic framework rejects racial organising.

racial-pride.rationale: Not addressed; national, not racial, framing.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Inferred from Montenegrin neutrality in the Kosovo War and NATO defensive alliance.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Montenegrin nationalists insist that sharing a language with Serbs does not make one nation; language is marked as a self-determination issue.

communal-electorates.rationale: Inferred from the constitution's equal citizenship.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Not addressed; the movement itself opposed Serbian designs but does not allege a partition plot.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from the Euro-Atlantic orientation; not documented.

capital-controls.rationale: Inferred from market orientation and the euro.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Inferred from the rule-of-law state, though Montenegrin gun culture exists.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Inferred from state loyalty and NATO membership.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Inferred from the social-democratic party orientation.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The movement built a state through a referendum and constitution.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Not addressed beyond the ecological-state clause.

sacred-nation.rationale: Not addressed; mixed religious and secular tones.

public-service-media.rationale: Inferred from the democratic framework and EU alignment.

missingStatements.text: A people has the right to its own national church, independent of the church of a neighbouring nation.
missingStatements.rationale: The Montenegrin Orthodox Church was founded in 1993 to claim an autocephalous national church, central to the movement's identity campaign.

missingStatements.text: The name of a people's language is for its speakers to decide, even where it is mutually intelligible with a neighbour's.
missingStatements.rationale: Supporters frame naming Montenegrin as a matter of self-determination, over the objection that it is a new language.

notes: Most answers are low-confidence inferences because the movement is about identity, not a full programme. Civic and ethnic strands differ: the dominant party's civic line is used, while the historic Federalists and a post-2019 'ethnic nationalist' wing of the DPS would answer differently on some identity statements.
